name: luxury-broll
label: Luxury B-roll talking head (Iman Gadzhi-style)
description: Cinematic two-angle talking head over aspirational B-roll, accent-colour UI/graph pops, animation-dense intro (4-10 visuals/min) easing to ~2/min.

sync.broll: metaphor/aspirational B-roll on abstract nouns ('freedom', 'scale'), archival self-footage on story beats; ~50:50; full-frame 1.5-3 s
sync.fillers: reused chapter-card animation, UI/graph pops, angle switch on key phrases; every 4-8 s
sync.music: one moody bed per chapter, hits synced to chapter cards, B-roll montages on the beat, voice dominant
sync.emotion_map: aspiration → credibility → vulnerability (music thins) → resolve → desire
sync.transitions: cut on phrase, whoosh/blur into B-roll, light leaks

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
